---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement

---

## What problem does this solve?

What's the pain you're trying to remove? Who feels it?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see Shohoj do differently. Bullet points, screenshots, or sketches all welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you've used or other approaches you thought about.

## Phase / area

Which part of Shohoj does this touch? (Calculator, Planner, Reviews, Papers, Admin, Auth, etc.)

## Anything else

Links to related discussions, similar features in other apps, or context that would help.
